finalists.label: Dilated Cardiomyopathy
finalists.why: It accounts for the most decisive findings in the vignette, including dilated left ventricular cavity, low ejection fraction, and wide complex tachycardia.

finalists.label: Cardiac Sarcoidosis
finalists.why: It is specifically supported by the presence of cardiac granulomatous disease and patchy late gadolinium enhancement, which are unique to this condition.

finalists.label: Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction
finalists.why: It is supported by the low ejection fraction and high brain natriuretic peptide levels, which are characteristic of heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of cardiac granulomatous disease and patchy late gadolinium enhancement, as revealed by the PET scan and cardiac MRI, respectively, provide strong evidence for Cardiac Sarcoidosis.
